modules.title: Learning Centre home
modules.summary: Choose the shortest path to the result you need.
modules.outcome: Choose a guided path and know the evidence it should produce.

modules.title: First verified result
modules.summary: Complete a safe, bounded generation and verify its cost and location.
modules.outcome: Create, edit, save, and verify one small output.

modules.title: Choose an income path
modules.summary: Select one narrow operating loop without mistaking ideas for demand.
modules.outcome: Choose one measurable offer and its next evidence step.

modules.title: Navigate Imprint
modules.summary: Understand workspaces, agents, tabs, status, and the right rail.
modules.outcome: Move to the correct tool and interpret its current state.

modules.title: Projects, saving, and exports
modules.summary: Know what persists, what needs an explicit save, and where exports go.
modules.outcome: Create a clean project and recover its authoritative output.

modules.title: Providers, models, and Best Fit
modules.summary: Read recommendations correctly and override them for a measured reason.
modules.outcome: Choose an eligible route and explain why it fits the current task.

modules.title: Access, permissions, and privacy
modules.summary: Separate credentials, allowed providers, and data sent to a service.
modules.outcome: Enable only the routes you intend to use without exposing secrets.

modules.title: Costs, estimates, and limits
modules.summary: Preflight spend and reconcile estimates with recorded provider cost.
modules.outcome: Bound a paid action and know what its cost label permits you to conclude.

modules.title: Files, launcher, and recovery
modules.summary: Find outputs and diagnose live-launcher, packaged-app, and storage issues.
modules.outcome: Identify the running build and recover the relevant file or log.

modules.title: Studio Assistant
modules.summary: Use a saved conversation for a bounded question, with an eligible model and a checked result.
modules.outcome: Create one useful answer and recover its conversation safely.

modules.title: Book Author
modules.summary: Plan, draft, revise, and export long-form work with stable context.
modules.outcome: Produce an approved section that remains consistent with its project profile.

modules.title: Publishing Manager
modules.summary: Package, promote, and measure a finished manuscript.
modules.outcome: Move an approved manuscript through one traceable publishing task.

modules.title: Audiobook Producer
modules.summary: Convert supported books, inspect partial output, and resume listening.
modules.outcome: Create and verify a short narration sample before a full conversion.

modules.title: Music Artist Generator
modules.summary: Develop songs, albums, artist identity, releases, promotion, and measured income plans.
modules.outcome: Produce a generation-ready album concept and measurable release plan.

modules.title: Video & Ad Generator
modules.summary: Choose between assembled and direct-generation routes and monitor the job safely.
modules.outcome: Render and find one bounded video with its route and cost understood.

modules.title: Social Media Campaign Manager
modules.summary: Create, schedule, review, and publish platform-specific campaign assets.
modules.outcome: Move one approved draft into a traceable posting state.

modules.title: Web Developer
modules.summary: Generate, inspect, save, and verify a responsive web deliverable.
modules.outcome: Export a locally reviewed page that meets a written acceptance checklist.

modules.title: Brand & Logo Designer
modules.summary: Turn a bounded brand brief into reviewed client assets and an order record.
modules.outcome: Prepare one scoped delivery with acceptance and revision boundaries.

modules.title: Brand Creator
modules.summary: Operate profiles, campaigns, assets, earnings, voices, agencies, and records safely.
modules.outcome: Create one authorised campaign asset and connect it to a measured account outcome.

modules.title: Venture Agent
modules.summary: Turn directional signals into bounded Brand Creator experiments and reconcile owned actuals.
modules.outcome: Select one opportunity, design its test, and state what each dashboard can prove.

modules.title: Evidence before production
modules.summary: Label observations, proxies, estimates, hypotheses, generated ideas, and demo data honestly.
modules.outcome: Complete an evidence passport and know what the evidence permits.

modules.title: Define one measurable offer
modules.summary: Specify the buyer, problem, deliverable, price, channel, and accepted outcome.
modules.outcome: Write one offer whose funnel and fulfilment can be measured.

modules.title: Design a fair experiment
modules.summary: Pre-register one comparison, decision rule, sample/window, and guardrail.
modules.outcome: Create a fixed experiment card before seeing results.

modules.title: Unit economics
modules.summary: Calculate cash and economic contribution with complete variable costs and owner time.
modules.outcome: Know whether one accepted outcome creates value in the observed window.

modules.title: Funnels, attribution, and cohorts
modules.summary: Keep raw stage counts, source limits, periods, and currencies comparable.
modules.outcome: Build a funnel that does not invent attribution or mix incompatible cohorts.

modules.title: Uncertainty and decisions
modules.summary: Interpret noisy results and choose stop, repair, repeat, or scale.
modules.outcome: Make one decision without calling a small noisy difference a winner.

modules.title: Automation maturity and review
modules.summary: Automate reversible, observable work only after economic and quality evidence repeats.
modules.outcome: Pass or fail a workflow against the automation promotion gate.
